chapter.title: The Queen Meets a Full Stop
chapter.subtitle: In a court where words change size, Alice asks for rules that stay put.
chapter.description: In a court where words change size, Alice asks for rules that stay put.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: You left before the host finished saying goodbye.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: You were on goodbye number nineteen.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: The law is clear.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Then why is the clerk still writing it?

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: Her gold seal fell off the original napkin. The words underneath got cut into strips for the shredder.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Rebuild the actual promise. She can yell after we know what she signed.

puzzle.title: The promise under the seal
puzzle.instruction: Rebuild the five strips into the Queen’s original sentence. The torn-edge codes connect: the right edge of one strip matches the left edge of the next. START and END are outside edges. Read the result before submitting.
hints: Find START, then match the tear codes.
The permission “may” joins the guest to the action; the bell ends the sentence.
puzzle.solvedText: “Every guest may leave the party when the bell rings.” The gold seal covered the word “may.” Alice kept the signed napkin.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

preDialogue.speaker: Queen of Hearts
preDialogue.text: THE GUARDS WILL DEFEND THE HONOR OF MY TABLE.

preDialogue.speaker: Alice
preDialogue.text: Five rounds for access to the clerk’s exhibits. Say it now. I’m done discovering the rules at checkout.

preDialogue.speaker: Queen of Hearts
preDialogue.text: Five. And no folding the guards.

postDialogue.speaker: Cheshire
postDialogue.text: One guard folded himself under pressure. We should get him laminated.

postDialogue.speaker: Alice
postDialogue.text: Evidence drawer is open. Fresh ink, carbon sheet, delivery slip. Let’s compare.

passive.name: Cards on the Witness Stand
passive.description: Control two districts when the final round ends.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Law says yesterday. Delivery slip says the blank paper arrived today. Seal’s stuck to the lunch menu.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: My stationery moves differently.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: So does fraud, apparently.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: The clerk’s stamps survived. Rebuild the sequence and we can prove she wrote the rule after we left.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: THE CALENDAR IS BIASED.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: It gives you a whole birthday every year. What else you want?

puzzle.title: Yesterday has wet ink
puzzle.instruction: Order the five exhibits by their recorded sequence. Kitchen bell rings at noon. The clerk’s desk clock is 10 minutes fast; courier receipts use the correct clock.

pieces.label: Guests leave — bell
pieces.detail: Kitchen bell. Queen’s napkin permits departure at this signal.

pieces.label: Rule written — 12:16
pieces.detail: Clerk clock. Writing appears on the newly delivered page.

pieces.label: Seal applied — 12:18
pieces.detail: Clerk clock. Gold seal crosses a wet word.

pieces.label: Summons delivered — 12:12
pieces.detail: Courier receipt. Quotes the newly sealed rule.

pieces.label: Blank paper delivered — 11:55
pieces.detail: Courier receipt. The packet is opened on camera, pages blank.

hints: The clerk’s readings must go backward ten minutes.
Writing happened at 12:06, sealing at 12:08, summons at 12:12.
puzzle.solvedText: The guests left at noon. The new rule was written six minutes later. The Queen’s date cannot change the recorded sequence.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: If I let people leave, how do I know they’ll come back?

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Serve hot food. Stop invoicing friendship.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: I spent all week arranging the table.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: And all week keeping us at it. The flowers have started a family.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Queen of Hearts
preDialogue.text: The old charge is dismissed. One final match. Winner writes next week’s invitation.

preDialogue.speaker: Alice
preDialogue.text: No compulsory attendance, no time debt. Those are settled.

preDialogue.speaker: Queen of Hearts
preDialogue.text: Fine. Six rounds. I get an extra Motion in round four.

preDialogue.speaker: Cheshire
preDialogue.text: Look at her. Announcing the scam in advance. Growth.

postDialogue.speaker: Queen of Hearts
postDialogue.text: Your invitation says “come through if you feel like it.” That’s the entire thing?

postDialogue.speaker: Cheshire
postDialogue.text: Put a crown on the envelope. You’ll live.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: I’m heading out.

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: Would you like a plate?

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: A plate I can take outside?

scenes.speaker: Queen of Hearts
scenes.text: Do not make this difficult.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: That’s a yes. Grab two.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Receipt says twelve minutes. We were gone two days.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: Time refund. No store credit.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Good. I’m taking a nap.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: Queen sent a reminder.

scenes.speaker: Alice
scenes.text: Mute it.

scenes.speaker: Cheshire
scenes.text: Already did. Felt incredible.
